description: 1920s Marina style detached home positioned for a full-scale redevelopment opportunity in the heart of Crocker Amazon. Classic architectural elements include hardwood floors, large formal rooms, and original built-ins, providing a compelling opportunity for a transformative project. The current layout features two bedrooms and one bath on the upper level, with additional bonus space and bath below.  The real showstopper: sweeping Downtown San Francisco skyline views from every level in the rear of the home...an exceptional vantage point that will elevate any end result.  The open garage currently offers one-car parking plus abundant storage, presenting a prime opportunity for expansion and reconfiguration of the lower level.  This is a contractor's special requiring comprehensive renovation, presenting a rare chance to reimagine the property from the ground up. Ideal for developers, investors, or seasoned end-users seeking to capitalize on location, scale, and views.  Unlock the full potential and deliver a standout residence in one of the most charming blocks of Crocker Amazon!
